## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. VXX rising (1W: +4.77% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY and credit stress rising (Credit Spread Level: 0.7534 | 1W: +0.38% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND both confirm mixed risk signals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress EASING/CONCERN: HYG (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND show tightening credit; Credit Spread rising (↑ rising) flags stress. Fear INCREASING: VXX (1W: +4.77% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY; Stocks vs Bonds flat: SPY/TLT (Level: 9.3814 | 1W: +0.14% | 1M: -0.77%) RECOVERY.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tight: TLT (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -1.34%) BELOW TREND and Yield Curve (Level: 0.9921 | 1W: -1.41% | 1M: -1.38%) ↓ falling indicate tighter conditions; Dollar softening: Dollar Strength (Level: 28.0300 | 1W: -0.18% | 1M: -0.53%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy is the lone leader on breadth while XLE shows a 1W/1M divergence: XLE (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +6.56%) CORRECTION and Energy sector 1W: +0.17% (only positive sector). Tech mixed: XLK (1W: +0.88% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY while Financials proxy XLF (1W: -0.95% | 1M: -1.72%) BELOW TREND → style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities soft: SPY (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.65%) BELOW TREND and QQQ (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -1.36%) BELOW TREND. EM regional split: EEM (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +2.40%) CORRECTION while China FXI (1W: -3.35% | 1M: -3.67%) BELOW TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Crypto mixed but still strong on 1M: IBIT (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +21.54%) CORRECTION and ETHA (1W: +2.83% | 1M: +30.89%) ABOVE TREND; small caps weak: IWM (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -4.42%) BELOW TREND, signaling reduced speculative breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity leadership centered on oil and agricultural goods: BNO (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +24.11%) ABOVE TREND; copper soft: CPER (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Oil strength pronounced: BNO ABOVE TREND and XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +6.56%), while natural gas shows short-term weakness: UNG (1W: -5.21% | 1M: +1.19%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Commodity/oil breakout (BNO (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) ABOVE TREND) and rising Credit Spread (0.7534 ↑) support divergent market regime. DIVERGENCE: multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches (IBIT, XLE, CORN, WEAT) constitute MINOR divergence but breadth (1/11) makes the market narrow and fragile.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Neutral posture: favor selective exposure to commodity/oil ETFs (BNO (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit; reduce exposure to small caps and discretionary: IWM (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -4.42%) BELOW TREND and XLY (1W: -2.52% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — BNO (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +6.56%) CORRECTION. BEARISH: Healthcare — XBI (1W: -5.17% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND and Industrials — XLI (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Oil/energy — USO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +24.11%) ABOVE TREND and BNO ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper and gas — CPER (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -5.21% | 1M: +1.19%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 watch for changing complacency: VXX (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -3.77%) RECOVERY and current VXX = 18.88. Credit health: Credit Spread 0.7534 (1W: +0.38% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND. Tech vs Financials pivot: XLK/XLF (Level: 3.2569 | 1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.54%) RECOVERY; SPY/TLT (Level: 9.3814 | 1W: +0.14% | 1M: -0.77%) RECOVERY.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive, with VXX rising (1W: +4.77% | 1M: -5.84%) RECOVERY and Credit Spread rising (0.7534 | 1W: +0.38% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND supporting a mixed backdrop. Commodities/oil showing relative strength (BNO (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) ABOVE TREND) while small caps and cyclicals (IWM (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -4.42%) BELOW TREND; XLY (1W: -2.52% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND) show weakness—monitor credit and the 1W vs 1M divergences.
